_how_to: Key by Sleeper handle. Any field set here replaces the generated one, e.g. "triccster": {"bio": "...", "photo": "/managers/tj.jpg", "favoriteTeam": "min", "location": "Maplewood"}. The special field "firstSeason" is not shown anywhere; /unclaimed uses it to stop offering a manager as a candidate for a team-season before he joined the league.
